title: Shore-Linked Net Drying Pier
description: One static shore-linked net-drying and tackle-preparation pier for the original fishing dock scene program. Two complete unchanged two-meter dock modules form a four-by-two-meter deck, with every original deck plank, gap, stringer, piling and collar preserved. A closed scene-only upper shore cap meets the rear deck level. One complete broad hanging-net rack stands entirely on that shore; one complete open worktable on the right dock supports one complete empty six-compartment open bait box on its real tabletop; one complete folding camping chair occupies the left dock. Six whole unrotated unit-scale instances from five published models, with one opaque water-colour datum and one shore cap as scene-only solids. The deck center and short shore/deck joining reference strip remain unoccupied. This is not the old unconnected four-tile cargo/rest platform with crates, barrel, sack, lifebuoy and mooring rope; it has a different linked shore, shallow two-tile work deck, a shore drying station and tabletop tackle preparation. It is also not the raised rocky-bank seatbox/creel/landing-net scene or the two-rod storage display rearranged on another surface. One scene and zero new models. Deck seams remain actual original twelve-millimeter gaps, not a seamless floor; no functional facility, catch, fluid simulation, load, buoyancy, safe access, human fit, real drying performance or hinge motion is asserted.
